name: Meike Long Stud Football Boots
title: Meike Long Stud Football Boots – Mesh Upper, TPU Studs, 4 Colours
description:
Long TPU stud football boots with a breathable mesh upper and a flexible wraparound ankle collar, made for training and match days on natural grass.

The TPU support spine limits twisting, and the long studs grip for quick stops, sharp turns and sprints. Available in White / Red, Beige / Orange, Pink and Gold, in sizes 35 to 45.
ingredients: Colours: White / Red, Beige / Orange, Pink, Gold
benefits: Wraparound ankle collar with a snug, flexible fit
Long TPU studs for grip on natural grass
TPU support spine to limit twisting
Breathable mesh upper
howToUse: Pick the EU size that matches your foot length. If you are between sizes, go one size up.
Wipe off mud after every session and let the boots air dry away from direct heat.
Keep them in a breathable bag, not a closed plastic one.

name: Meike F50 Football Boots
title: Meike F50 Football Boots – Synthetic Leather Upper, Long Studs, 3 Colours
description:
Meike F50 football boots with a streamlined synthetic leather upper and multi-directional long studs for grip on the pitch.

The forefoot has a dotted texture for better ball control. Available in Lavender / Green, Pink / Orange and White / Gold, in sizes 35 to 45.
ingredients: Forefoot: Dotted texture for ball control
Colours: Lavender / Green, Pink / Orange, White / Gold
benefits: Streamlined upper design
High-density synthetic leather
Multi-directional long studs for grip
Dotted forefoot texture for ball control
howToUse: Pick the EU size that matches your foot length. If you are between sizes, go one size up.
Wipe off mud after every session and let the boots air dry away from direct heat.
Keep them in a breathable bag, not a closed plastic one.

name: PEAK Football
title: PEAK Football – PVC Cover, Rubber Bladder, Size 4 & 5
description:
PEAK football for youth matches and training, with a soft PVC cover that is gentle on the feet, a rubber bladder for strong bounce, and a dense wound layer for durability.

The cover resists scratches and stains, and the ball is suitable for indoor and outdoor play. Available in Black / White, Blue / White and Yellow, in sizes 4 and 5.
ingredients: Cover: PVC, scratch and stain resistant
Colours: Black / White, Blue / White, Yellow
benefits: Soft cover that is gentle on the feet
Strong bounce, hard to burst
Scratch-resistant and stain-resistant cover
For indoor and outdoor play, easy to clean
howToUse: Size 5 is the standard match size. Size 4 is for younger players.
Inflate to a firm but not rock-hard pressure and keep the valve clean.
Wipe off mud with a damp cloth after play and store away from direct heat.

name: Striker Football Boots
title: Striker Football Boots – Spike (FG) and Flat (TF) Soles, 4 Colours
description:
Lightweight football boots with a textured synthetic upper and a snug lace-up fit. Choose the spike sole (long studs, FG) for natural grass or the flat sole (turf, TF) for artificial turf, concrete and hard grounds.

Available in White / Pink, Black / Green, Mint / Orange and Pink / Black, in sizes 35 to 45. See the sole and size guide in the gallery.
ingredients: Sole options: Spike (long studs, FG) or Flat (turf, TF)
Colours: White / Pink, Black / Green, Mint / Orange, Pink / Black
benefits: Lightweight textured upper
Long studs (FG) for grip on grass
Soft turf sole (TF) for artificial turf and hard grounds
Good choice for beginners (TF) and regular players (FG)
howToUse: Turf (TF) is the safe choice for children, teens and beginners and for artificial turf, plastic and cement floors.
Long stud (FG) is for players with some experience. Check that the ground suits long studs before you buy.
Pick the EU size from your foot length using the size guide. If you are between sizes, go one size up.
Wipe off mud after every session and let the boots air dry away from direct heat.

name: Grip Football Socks (2 Pair Pack)
title: Grip Football Socks – 2 Pair Pack, Anti-Slip, Long Over-Calf
description:
Long football grip socks with rubber grip dots on the leg and a cushioned, grippy sole, so your foot stays put inside the boot and your shin guard stays in place.

Each pack has 2 pairs. Pick any 2 colours from Black, White, Red and Blue. One free size fits most adults.
ingredients: Pack: 2 pairs, you choose the 2 colours
Grip: Rubber grip dots on the heel, leg and sole
benefits: Grip dots stop your foot sliding inside the boot
Grip on the leg helps hold shin guards in place
Cushioned sole for comfort on long sessions
Long over-calf length, stretch fit
howToUse: Choose your 2 colours, then add the pack to the cart. You get one pair of each colour.
Wash inside out in cool water and air dry so the grip dots last longer.
Do not iron the grip dots.

name: Ankle Support Compression Brace
title: Ankle Support Compression Brace – Slim 1mm, Adjustable Strap, 3 Colours
description:
Slim compression ankle support for football, running and gym. The high-stretch, skin-friendly fabric is as thin as 1mm, so it fits inside your boot or shoe without feeling bulky.

A Y-shaped strap with a strong velcro closure gives two-way compression around the ankle, and the open heel keeps it comfortable. Buy 1 piece for 199 tk or a pair for 357 tk. Available in Green, Purple and Grey / White.
ingredients: Design: Y-shaped strap, open heel, textured grip pattern
benefits: Two-way compression support for the ankle
Slim 1mm fabric, fits inside boots and shoes
Breathable, sweat-wicking and skin-friendly
Open heel and adjustable velcro strap
howToUse: Slide it over the foot and position it around the ankle with the heel open.
Wrap the strap around the ankle in a Y shape and press the velcro closed. Adjust the tightness so it is firm but comfortable.
Wash by hand in cool water and air dry. Keep the velcro clean.

name: Shin Guard and Sleeve Set
title: Shin Guard and Sleeve Set – Shin Pads with Pocket Sleeves, 3 Colours
description:
2-piece football set: 1 pair of shin guards and 1 pair of mesh sleeves with a built-in pocket.

Slide the shin guard into the sleeve pocket and pull the sleeve on. The guard stays in place on the shin without tape, and the breathable mesh keeps your leg cool. Available in White, Black and Blue.
ingredients: Set: 1 pair of shin guards + 1 pair of sleeves
Sleeves: Breathable mesh with a pocket for the guard
benefits: Guard stays in place, no tape needed
Breathable mesh sleeve
Pocket holds the shin guard securely
Light hard-shell protection for matches and training
howToUse: Put the shin guard into the pocket of the sleeve.
Pull the sleeve onto your leg with the guard over the shin, then put your football socks on top if you like.
Wash the sleeves by hand and air dry. Wipe the guards clean with a damp cloth.
